speaker: Asa
quote: I will hold the catch while you carry. Show me where the load can rest. I am not your second carrier.
text: I will hold the catch while you carry. Show me where the load can rest. I am not your second carrier.

speaker: Asa
quote: Watch where the weight can stop. Not how quickly you can make it move.
text: Watch where the weight can stop. Not how quickly you can make it move.

speaker: Asa
quote: Use the support you actually have. A promise won't hold the bottom of this case.
text: Use the support you actually have. A promise won't hold the bottom of this case.

speaker: Asa
quote: The gate is mine. The weight is yours. Call down before the bend if you need the landing.
text: The gate is mine. The weight is yours. Call down before the bend if you need the landing.

speaker: Asa
quote: Put it down flat. The stamp is still the clerk's work.
text: Put it down flat. The stamp is still the clerk's work.

speaker: Asa
quote: The case stays under the hood. A stopped carry is not a lost parcel.
text: The case stays under the hood. A stopped carry is not a lost parcel.

speaker: Asa
quote: You called down, and there was somewhere to put it. That's work I can do with you.
text: You called down, and there was somewhere to put it. That's work I can do with you.

speaker: Asa
quote: You stopped before the seal opened. How it went on from there belongs in the clinic ledger.
text: You stopped before the seal opened. How it went on from there belongs in the clinic ledger.

speaker: Asa
quote: A no before the weight is in the air is a useful word. Keep it available.
text: A no before the weight is in the air is a useful word. Keep it available.

speaker: Asa
quote: We never finished that carry. The rest belongs in the clinic ledger.
